notes: Rule (cite.py --check 8.4.2.3.3 'ALL shall not be specified if qualified-condition-name-1 is specified.' -> OK §8.4.2.3.3 7)). No path admits ALL on a condition-name: the only two ALL-admitting contexts (§8.4.2.3.3 SR6) take a data item (intrinsic argument / SORT data-name-2), and everywhere else the ALL segment fails the subscript parse. Every illegal spelling is refused at compile time; the COBOL2363 text names SR6 rather than SR7 (diagnostic wording only - SR6 independently forbids each of these).
